summary_1line: Bhishma teaches that self-restraint and penance are the roots of virtue, purification, and liberation, enabling one to attain knowledge, happiness, and ultimately Brahma.

image_candidates.scene_text: An emaciated sage sits in deep austerity beneath a forest tree, radiating calm while visions of the three worlds appear before his closed eyes.
A serene ascetic walks unnoticed along a forest path while birds cross the sky and their tracks vanish instantly, symbolizing the unseen path of the self-restrained.
